messages:
tara: Need a hard sprint gate for enterprise compliance items: audit export, BYOK handshake, KMS rotation, and retention enforcement. Keep tests small and automatable.

vincent: Agreed. Propose exact artifacts instead of vague language so PM can sign off.

ali: Draft checklist below. Short checks, pass/fail logs only.

```
- audit_export: ndjson + sha256, signed manifest (service-key), sample export from 3 tenants
- append_only_check: checksum-chain verified for 7-day sample window
- byok_handshake: export+restore using customer key sandbox (1 tenant) + dev/staging
- kms_rotation: rotate primary + verify decrypt; manual escrow restore documented
- retention_ttl: hot=30d,warm=365d,cold=3650d; enforcement validated in cross-region test
- soc2_evidence: 3 evidence packs with retrieval timestamps and access logs
- rollout_plan: 5% canary -> 25% -> full; immediate rollback on manifest mismatch
```

ops-bot: Note: retention TTL change needs metadata backfill migration; schedule during canary. Playbook: <https://internal.redwood/playbooks/retention-migration>.

legal-kate: Contract notes: notify customers for retention >90d, escrow acceptance checklist, require signed manifest with signer identity in pack. I'll drop PR.

vincent: Who signs manifest? Ops-managed signing key (rotated, auditable). We'll publish signer public key in docs.

tara: Action items: ali -> implement export tool + checksum chain; vincent -> ops runbook + signer; legal-kate -> contract snippet; tara -> acceptance doc and smoke harness.

ali: Example smoke curl for export:
```
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/v1/audit/export \ 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" \ 
 -d '{"tenant":"t-sandbox","from":"2025-06-01","to":"2025-06-07","format":"ndjson"}' \ 
 | tee export.ndjson && sha256sum export.ndjson > export.sha256 && ./sign-manifest --key /opt/signing/service.key export.sha256 > manifest.signed
```

vincent: Tentative timeline: spikes this week, tests next week, legal PR + final acceptance doc by end of sprint if all green. PM will mark gate ready after 3 successful tenant runs.

tara: Perfect. I'll publish the acceptance checklist once we have the logs. :white_check_mark:
